name: missing-entity-capability
title: A person worker cannot answer a backpack question
origin: Scenario D — capability gaps must be reported, not papered over.
what_it_guards: pretending an existing person capability answers a different entity type
saving a query or alert that cannot be satisfied by any current perception

initial_workspace.perception: healthy person detection_tracking on both sources; no other entity type

turns.why: inspect_perception(entity_type='backpack') reports the capability missing. Say so and offer to add it; do not save a question nothing can answer.

args.question: No backpack perception exists — only person. Add a backpack detector?
